verdicts.reason: A keeps a full-width header and a clean centred stack, but the sun logo looks squashed flat, there is a big dead gap between the headline and the body copy, the orange divider has moved below the body copy so it no longer separates headline from body, and the legal text is microscopic. B's dark header bar is visibly broken: it doesn't reach the right edge and sits inset from the left. It also has a large empty gap between the eyebrow and the headline, and 'Ships late June' floats far below the CTA, cut off from its button, so the spacing looks arbitrary even though the headline reads well.
